features: Bluetooth 5.0 + 2.4GHz Dual-Mode – Connect to Any Device: Switch seamlessly between Bluetooth 5.0 and 2.4GHz wireless modes, letting you use the same mouse with MacBooks, iPads, Android tablets, Windows laptops, and desktops — all without carrying multiple devices.

Type-C Rechargeable – No Disposable Batteries Ever: Built-in 500mAh battery with fast Type-C USB charging eliminates the ongoing cost and inconvenience of replacing AA batteries — just charge and keep working for extended sessions.

1600 DPI Precision with 4D Buttons – Smooth Control at Every Speed: High-accuracy 1600 DPI optical sensor combined with 4-directional button support gives you precise, responsive navigation for office work, creative tasks, and casual gaming.

Multicolor LED Lighting – Personalised Aesthetic: Dynamic LED lighting adds visual personality to your workspace or gaming setup, complementing the EnGrip's sleek, modern form without affecting battery life significantly.

Slim Ergonomic Build – Portable & Comfortable – 1 Year Warranty: Lightweight, slim design with a comfortable grip is ideal for travel and daily carry. Backed by EVM's 1-Year manufacturer warranty for worry-free ownership.
description: Upgrade your typing experience with the WIRED KEYBOARD (EVM-WDK-216). This keyboard features a total of 104 keys, providing you with a full keyboard layout for efficient typing and navigation. Its spill-resistant design ensures durability by withstanding accidental spills, while the high-quality copper wire construction guarantees reliable connectivity and performance. With a generous 1.2m cable length, this keyboard offers convenient connectivity to your computer or laptop. The UV paint coating provides a sleek and durable finish that resists fading over time, maintaining its aesthetic appeal. Simply plug and play with USB connectivity, making it compatible with a wide range of devices. Experience smooth and responsive keystrokes for a comfortable typing experience, allowing you to work or play with ease. Plus, with a 1-year warranty, you can purchase with confidence knowing that your investment is protected.
